phase2.weights: 1/(distance+.25), normalized to sum to neighbor count; include all boundary ties; geographic control uses identical rule
phase2.distance: geographic and physical normalized by training nearest positive distance; mixed=.5 each
phase2.compact_corrector: same EN12 grid and amplitude0/.25/.5 as original; each k pipeline fully tuned inside each outer inner training; select k from complete honest internal OOF

phase3.targets: Honest OOF errors of the entire original Local+compact EN, deep targets regenerated within inner training only

fallback: For a leader training context unable to support grouped nested EN selection or fixed local >=3 parcels, retire compact EN and use fixed local only; never switch grouped to random; record every occurrence. For original local <3 training parcels, return training mean.
representation: Original leader retains archived transductive PCA20 on197X; physical spaces and distance normalizations refit on corresponding train; texture categorical onehot without rare-class variance scaling; geologic roots and standardized log structural distances; no admin/coords in physical spaces.
selection: Complete internal OOF MSE; ties grid order, then smaller correction amplitude; phase selectors use internal candidate scores, not external results.
evaluation: Same65 outer/frozen inner; exploratory follow-up informed by earlier folds, no independent confirmation; no GeoC97/41 in this phase; no final138 or PRED59.
